Panchang.pickerHint: Janamdin, saalgirah, ya koi aane wali tareekh. Apne sabse paas ka shehar chuniye, kyunki din ki tithi suryoday se tay hoti hai.
Panchang.method: Yeh maan {city} ke liye Surya aur Chandra ki sthiti se, Lahiri ayanamsa ke saath nikale gaye hain. Tithi, nakshatra, yoga aur karana wahi hain jo suryoday ke samay chal rahe hote hain, jaise chhape hue panchang mein hota hai. Hum is ganana ko ek doosre astronomy engine se aur {minYear} se {maxYear} tak NASA ki prakashit grahan tareekhon se milate hain.
Panchang.methodCaveat: Alag-alag kshetra ke panchang apni parampara maante hain, isliye kuch tyoharon mein ek din ka fark ho sakta hai. Panchang ek paramparik calendar hai jo margdarshan ke liye hai. Yeh koi bhavishyavani ya guarantee nahi hai.
